newsitem.title: USA: West Coast postpones junk deal - source.
newsitem.headline: West Coast postpones junk deal - source.

text.p: West Coast Entertainment Corp has postponed a 144a private placement of $110 million in junk bonds due to poor market conditions, said a source close to the deal.
Credit Suisse First Boston Corp was the lead-underwriter of the offering of seven-year senior notes which had been rated B2/B.
The company and Credit Suisse were unable to complete the deal despite increasing price talk to 11 percent to 11 1/4 percent from an original range of 10 5/8 to 10 7/8, sources said.
